```lean
by {
  -- Since ModuleCat R is a preadditive category with all finite limits and colimits,
  -- it follows that it has finite biproducts.
  -- This is a consequence of the fact that additive categories with finite limits and colimits
  -- have finite biproducts (see, for example, the Karoubi envelope construction).
  refine CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts.ofHasFiniteLimitsAndColimits _
  · exact ModuleCat.hasLimits
  · exact ModuleCat.instHasFiniteColimits
}
```
